notablePrerequisites: Helga has power 8 or greater and does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Helga by tapping it, adding at least eight {U} that can only be spent to cast creature spell with mana value 4 or greater or with {X} in their mana cost.
Cast Hoverguard Sweepers by paying its mana cost.
Helga and Chakram Retriever trigger.
Resolve the Helga trigger, causing you to draw a card, gain 1 life, and put a +1/+1 counter on Helga.
Resolve the Chakram Retriever trigger, causing you to untap Helga.
When Hoverguard Sweepers enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning it and up to one other creature from the battlefield to their owner's hand.
Repeat.
